verdict.rationale: Orrick's free Tech Studio offers 50+ forms and document generators, 300+ articles and an FAQ database, including formation material such as a German Incorporation Questionnaire. A founder on Hacker News reports using Orrick's documents to form their company, so formation materials exist. However, nothing in the evidence specifically addresses founder vesting schedules, 83(b) elections or co-founder equity splits. Missing for 10: explicit founder vesting content or templates, 83(b) or local-equivalent guidance, co-founder equity split guidance, and independent corroboration of these specific materials.
